texto.@es: Las recetas presentan ingredientes con cantidades y luego pasos en imperativo. Busca unidades como gram y minuut; distingue preparar, mezclar y hornear.
texto.@en: The recipes present ingredients with quantities and then steps in imperative. Search for units such as gram and minuut; it distinguishes to prepare, mix and bake.
